about: The playthrough trains for Falkner, from Violet City's Pokemon Center after his Bird Keepers, the cap at 13: Route 32's first grass, just south of the city and north of the man who walks up to the player (a coord event at (475, 305) the walks never reach), where the night's Pokemon are levels 8 to 12 -- Wooper, Poliwag, Doduo, Marill, Bellsprout, Mareep, Gulpin, Shinx, Combee, Machop -- and pay a level-11 Pokemon four times what Route 31's 4 to 7 do. The Misdreavus, then the Cyndaquil, each put first, and pace: walks two tiles of that grass until it has 13; flee:40 runs from a battle once the one fighting is low and heal: takes it to the nurse between two walks, running from everything on the way. New moves come by gym.py's rule: the Cyndaquil's Quick Attack takes Smokescreen's place (on the merged tree of round 14 it comes at 13 with it, from leg 04i). Then the Hoothoot leads, and pace: trains it to 10 first: on the merged tree Bird Keeper Rod falls to the Misdreavus and the Cyndaquil in leg 04i and the Hoothoot comes at 8, where the leg was written at 10, the level leg 04k expects it at and Falkner was beaten with. Then catch:SPECIES_MAREEP has the walks catch a Mareep -- a tenth of the night's grass, catch rate 235, one of the bag's three Poke Balls -- while the Hoothoot wins what the others pay: Falkner beat the four nine times running with the Hoothoot at 10, and an Electric type is a player's answer to his birds. Where the leg was written a Mareep came at level 11 on the Hoothoot's ninth walk and the ball held (26,892 frames); the joined chain on the merged tree trains the Hoothoot from 8 to 10 in some 47,000 frames, then catches a Mareep at 11 with one ball, 118,304 frames in all, the playthrough's longest leg. The nurse, and the game's save. The party is the bot's own, no edit: this leg and the next are what leg 05's savedit --level stood in for. The field's RNG is pinned and the battle's seed fixed.
